thread:
alex-mlinfra: Quick heads-up: ran holiday traffic sim with current routing + 20% growth; median GPU-hours = 2.2x baseline, p95 latency risk in eu-west if we keep current buffers. Suggest we discuss regional buffer + prewarm plan.
maria-sre: thanks. can you share the sim inputs? do we model bursty 10-15min microbursts?
alex-mlinfra: yes — 30s-10min bursts, mix of chat+embed. sim link: https://redwood.internal/sims/holiday-2026 (placeholder). key output: eu-west capacity hit at ~75%>90% in peak windows.
jin-capacity: assuming autoscaler cooldowns at 60s we under-scale. propose reducing cooldown to 20s for bursty queue + 2 reserved nodes per az as buffer.
sam-prod: cost impact? finance needs an order-of-magnitude for reserved GPUs.
alex-mlinfra: rough calc: reserved 8 A100 across eu-west for 3 days = ~576 GPU-hours -> est ~$42k. will prod a finer number and a per-hour breakdown.
lia-engr: also consider model-quantized fallback path (q4_k) - cuts 30-40% GPU usage but increases latency ~10ms.
maria-sre: any network hotspots? last holiday we saw control-plane flapping between regions.
jin-capacity: inter-region egress spike is a concern if we route to fallback region. prefer local prewarm + soft-fallback TTL=5s to abort cross-region early.
prov-bot: quota check: eu-west GPU quota is 120. Requested by jin-capacity: +16. Status: pending.
alex-mlinfra: proposal: prewarm 6 nodes per az starting -2h, reserved 8 GPUs for guaranteed capacity, autoscaler cooldown 20s, fallback to quantized model, tracing + canary at -1h.
sam-prod: ok get me the exact GPU-hour delta + cost delta by EOD, I'll loop in finance.
maria-sre: runbook checklist: alerts for node eviction, per-az CPU throttle, control-plane API error rate >1% -> trigger fallback. Add canary traffic at 1% and ramp.
jin-capacity: config snippet for autoscaler we'll use:
```
scaleDownDelay: 20s
scaleUpPolicy: burst
reservedInstancesPerAZ: 2
```
(we'll validate with sim).
lia-engr: test note: include model switch regressions in eval harness. If fallback changes logits significantly, ops can't accept silent quality drop.
alex-mlinfra: tracking thread; I'll upload final numbers + GCP quota ticket link. tagging @maria-sre @jin-capacity for runbook sign-off.
deploy-bot: scheduled action: canary rollout at 2026-11-26T23:00Z if manual approve.
maria-sre: sign-off pending final cost. also add postmortem owner (lia-engr) if anything degrades.
sam-prod: approved to contact cloud sales for temporary burst quota.
